courses.overview: 由多層堆疊、回流路徑與製造驗證延伸到兩種可繼續實作的工法；比較共享物理關係與不能直接複製的條件。
courses.overviewEn: Extend multilayer stackup, return paths and manufacturing verification into two guided courses, comparing shared physical relations and nontransferable conditions.

related.title: 高密度互連電路板
related.why: HDI 保留多層板堆疊與回流設計原則。
related.whyEn: HDI retains multilayer stackup and return-path principles.
related.transfer: HDI 保留多層板堆疊與回流設計原則。
related.transferEn: HDI retains multilayer stackup and return-path principles.
related.difference: 微孔增層帶來不同孔底界面、壓合與檢驗要求。
related.differenceEn: Microvia buildup adds different bottom interfaces, lamination and inspection needs.
practice: 把「層疊材料」的概念圖與「高密度互連電路板」的輸入輸出對照。
比較設計線寬、製造補償值與截面實測。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：微孔增層帶來不同孔底界面、壓合與檢驗要求。
practiceEn: Compare the stack materials concept map with inputs/outputs of High-density interconnect circuit boards.
Compare design, compensated and cross-section widths.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Microvia buildup adds different bottom interfaces, lamination and inspection needs.

related.title: 軟硬複合電路板
related.why: 軟硬複合板也需要層疊、連通與阻抗控制。
related.whyEn: Rigid-flex also needs stackup, connectivity and impedance control.
related.transfer: 軟硬複合板也需要層疊、連通與阻抗控制。
related.transferEn: Rigid-flex also needs stackup, connectivity and impedance control.
related.difference: 活動彎折引入中性軸和銅疲勞，不可只沿用剛板厚度。
related.differenceEn: Dynamic bending adds neutral-axis and copper-fatigue limits; rigid thickness rules do not transfer.
practice: 把「對稱堆疊」的概念圖與「軟硬複合電路板」的輸入輸出對照。
用截面標注最薄鍍層及環寬。
用一項可重算的量或反例檢查差異：活動彎折引入中性軸和銅疲勞，不可只沿用剛板厚度。
practiceEn: Compare the symmetric stackup concept map with inputs/outputs of Rigid-flex circuit boards.
Annotate minimum plating and annular ring on a section.
Test the difference with a reproducible quantity or counterexample: Dynamic bending adds neutral-axis and copper-fatigue limits; rigid thickness rules do not transfer.

courses.summary: 多層印刷電路板製造以多層堆疊、回流路徑與製造驗證連結元件、系統和驗證。此定位提供公開供應鏈或工程案例的地理背景。
courses.summaryEn: Multilayer printed-circuit-board manufacturing links components, systems and validation through multilayer stackup, return paths and manufacturing verification. The location gives public supply-chain or case geography.
courses.connection: 比較相關課程時，保留本課的基本模型，重新核對材料、規模、環境與驗收邊界。
courses.connectionEn: Transfer the basic models to related courses while rechecking materials, scale, environment and acceptance boundaries.

history.title: 從元件機制到系統設計
history.titleEn: From component mechanisms to system design
history.text: Eurocircuits 的原廠技術資料提供本課的可追溯起點。核心板、半固化片與銅箔扮演不同結構角色。 本課以自行編写的教學模型連到「多層堆疊、回流路徑與製造驗證」，不主張地圖所標機構發明了全部技術。
history.textEn: Manufacturer documentation from Eurocircuits provides a traceable starting point. Cores, prepreg and copper foil have different structural roles. Independently authored models connect this to multilayer stackup, return paths and manufacturing verification; the mapped organization is not claimed to have invented all these techniques.

history.title: 從標稱數據走向驗證證據
history.titleEn: From nominal metrics to verification evidence
history.text: 本課進一步處理這個系統問題：高速回流傾向靠近訊號路徑，跨參考平面裂縫會擴大迴路。 以「在走線上逐段畫出對應回流。」練習判讀；這段是公開原理的學習脈絡，不是機構的發明年表。
history.textEn: The course then examines a system issue: High-frequency returns stay near signals; crossing reference splits enlarges loops. Practice interpretation using: Draw the return path along each trace segment. This is public-principle learning context, not an institutional invention timeline.
